# PngSuite fixtures

This directory contains the 161 valid PNG images from PngSuite. Files whose
names begin with `x` are intentionally corrupted and are not included because
PNG error-recovery behavior varies between decoders.

Source: <https://github.com/lunapaint/pngsuite>

Commit: `8cd768dd0d0063195174d0d01cacbd5a7d1e5605`

The original permission notice is in `LICENSE.txt`.
